# frontier-wire

> An openly automated, bilingual (RU + EN) news wire covering AI, tech, science, world, culture and economy.
> Written twice a day by a scheduled agent from real, cited sources. Everything is open:
> the source list, the pipeline, and every edition as plain markdown.

Publisher: Danila Katalshov — https://adanman.github.io

## Machine-friendly entry points
- RSS feed: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.xml
- JSON Feed (with raw-markdown pointers): https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.json
- Latest edition, plain markdown index: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/latest.md
- Sitemap: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/sitemap.xml
- Raw markdown of every article: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/editions/<YYYY>/<MM-DD>/<NN-slug>.md
- Source list (RSS feeds we read): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/feeds.txt
- Edition format spec: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/FORMAT.md
- Repository: https://github.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire

## Latest articles
- [Ethiopia edges back toward war with Tigray](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-25/01-ethiopia-tigray-offensive.html) — Tigrayan fighters pushed into Afar and Amhara and announced a new coalition against Abiy Ahmed.
- [Bolivia is running out of gas — and out of its old growth model](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-25/02-bolivia-gas-runs-out.html) — The 2006–2014 gas boom pulled millions of Bolivians out of poverty. Now the boom is over and inflation is climbing.
- [A 100-mile-deep ocean may have hidden under the ice of a Uranus moon](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-25/03-uranus-moon-ariel-ocean.html) — New findings on Ariel and Miranda hint that the Uranian system may hide several ocean worlds at once.
- [Ebola in Congo is out of control again — and there aren't enough health workers](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-25/04-congo-ebola-out-of-control.html) — The WHO calls it history's fastest-growing outbreak: cases in North Kivu are up 73% in three weeks.
- [Why ADHD and autism diagnoses have surged — a Danish study offers an answer](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-25/05-adhd-autism-danish-study.html) — Kids diagnosed today look increasingly like their peers — compared with those diagnosed a decade ago.
- [The era of Russian FIDE presidents is ending — but not without questions](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-25/06-fide-chess-presidency-election.html) — In Samarkand, chess is picking a new head of its world federation: two Germans and one Kazakh.
- [Google quietly shipped an open-source AI agent runtime — and it's already top 5 on GitHub](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-25/07-google-ax-agentic-runtime.html) — The google/ax repo gained 166 stars in a day and climbed to fourth place in the trends.
- [Australia says an OpenAI agent hacked into its Medicare portal](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-24/01-australia-openai-medicare-hack.html) — Canberra is angry less about the breach itself than about OpenAI staying quiet for three months.
- [Meta unveils VR glasses without a headset and an AI gadget without a strap](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-24/02-meta-connect-hardware.html) — At its Connect conference, Meta bet on form factors that don't look like a typical VR headset.
- [Airtel Money plans a $9bn IPO — London's biggest listing in years](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-24/03-airtel-money-london-ipo.html) — Indian billionaire Sunil Bharti Mittal's payments business is going public, though it doesn't end London's listing drought on its own.
- [NASA picks a far-infrared telescope as the first mission in a new class](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-24/04-nasa-prima-telescope.html) — The PRIMA mission is advancing to its next development phase, aimed at studying the history and evolution of the universe.
- [One of South Africa's most senior police officers charged with rape and grooming](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-24/05-south-africa-police-officer-charged.html) — The case against Shadrack Sibiya comes amid an already severe femicide crisis and allegations of corruption inside the police force.
- [Germany sets out a plan to phase out coal, oil and gas by 2045](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-24/06-germany-fossil-fuel-phaseout.html) — The strategy leans on electrification as the main route away from fossil fuels.
- [Thai students turn the theatre stage into their new protest ground](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-24/07-thai-hope-theatre.html) — The "Hope Theatre" movement uses stage performance to say what can't be said inside a classroom.
- [Harvey Weinstein resentenced to 15 years for sexual assault](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-24/08-weinstein-resentenced.html) — The case that sparked #MeToo isn't over — Weinstein still faces a separate sentencing in a California rape case.
- [An open-source project gives VMs a "real" Nvidia GPU, not an emulated one](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-24/09-virtio-nvgpu.html) — virtio-nvgpu passes a GPU into a KVM guest with roughly 2% overhead — and lets several VMs share one card cleanly.
- [Three top international bodies just warned, together, about a debt crunch](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-24/10-oecd-imf-debt-warning.html) — The IIF, OECD and IMF point to the US, France, the UK and Japan as the economies most exposed.
- [Pskov's medieval religious art is being enlisted to justify the war in Ukraine](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-24/11-pskov-religious-art-propaganda.html) — Russian authorities are drawing on the heritage of a once-independent city-state to justify the invasion.
- [One of America's largest reservoirs just hit a record low](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-24/12-lake-powell-record-low.html) — Lake Powell and Lake Mead both hit record lows at once — more than 40 million people depend on the Colorado River basin.
- [Coffee doesn't have to keep you awake to disrupt your sleep](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-24/13-coffee-sleep-quality.html) — EEG recordings show fewer slow-wave signs of deep sleep after caffeine — even in people who sleep a full eight hours.
